summary: Session-gated render dispatch. When the session-type global dword_7C56A4 equals 7 and the phase global dword_7C56A8 is 2, 3 or 4, forwards the three arguments to SingleFunctionDispatch_10e0 (0x004D10E0) and returns 1; otherwise forwards them to RenderCallWithGuard (0x004D1140) and returns 0. Frame-path helper called by sub_4C6B60 (0x004C6B60) and SceneRenderUpdate (0x004C6D90).

operations.description: Dispatch-race guard: take the race-dispatch branch only when dword_7C56A4 == 7 and dword_7C56A8 is 2, 3 or 4; otherwise take the generic-render branch.
When the guard matches, call SingleFunctionDispatch_10e0(0x004D10E0) with (a1, a2, a3).
When the guard does not match, call RenderCallWithGuard(0x004D1140) with (a1, a2, a3).
